Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-daroe022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual2-Dark/large/daroe.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual2-Dark/large/daroe.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). * '''PC-E1''' ([[Daroe (V) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 26 October 2022<ref name="img-daroeab7dedd">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual2-Dark/large/daroe.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab7deddc7ba5815bab0aff7ba0699002f6647d34 commit ab7dedd] (26 October 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual2-Dark/large/daroe.gif (today's copy is the latest version only).
